Subject: Re: Vendor contract - need your sign-off by Friday
Thanks for the update. I have a couple of questions regarding the points you mentioned:
1. Regarding the payment term, [approve 60-day term? yes/no].
2. Regarding the liability cap, [approve liability cap? yes/no].
Once I have your confirmation, I can sign off and we can proceed.
Subject: Re: Can we move Thursday's sync?
Thanks for letting me know. I can make the sync work on Friday morning. [pick 10am/11am/12pm] works for
me. Please send the updated invite.
Thanks for reaching out. I need to confirm whether the extra Rs 25,000 is for an additional training
day. [confirm training day? yes/no]. If it is, please send a revised invoice reflecting the correct
amount. Our payment run is on Monday, so a prompt update would be appreciated.
